children: Palm oil (FCPOc3) may revisit its August 21 high of 5,031 ringgit per metric ton, as it has almost recovered from a drop to the August 28 low of 4,799 ringgit.
The recovery suggests a continuation of the uptrend from 4,462 ringgit, although the trend was disrupted by a mild consolidation in the narrow range of 4,949-4,990 ringgit.
The trend has been developing within a rising channel, which indicates an aggressive target of 5,166 ringgit. A realistic target range is from 5,032 ringgit to 5,083 ringgit.
A break below 4,949 ringgit may trigger a fall to 4,897 ringgit. On the hourly chart, a bullish flag has been confirmed, suggesting a target around 5,130 ringgit.
As long as the market stays above 4,958 ringgit, the bullish view will remain unchanged.
